:::{#exm-theorem}
#### A corollary of a result

@exm-proof proves the result
"the sum of two even integers is even".
A corollary follows with little extra work:
the sum of three even integers $a$, $b$, and $c$ is even,
because $a + b + c = (a + b) + c$,
$a + b$ is even by that result,
and applying the result again to the even integers $a + b$ and $c$
shows that $(a + b) + c$ is even.
For example,

$$
\begin{aligned}
2 + 4 + 6 &= (2 + 4) + 6 \\
&= 6 + 6 \\
&= 12,
\end{aligned}
$$

which is even.

:::
